reviews.rationale: Complete adopted June4,2026 H.Res.518 EH directs immediate consideration of H.R.2913, waives consideration/provision points of order, treats the bill as read, orders the previous question with one-hour divided Foreign Affairs debate and one recommittal motion. Section2 makes rule XIX clause1(c) and rule XX clause8 inapplicable to that consideration; section3 directs a Clerk message to the Senate no later than ONE WEEK AFTER PASSAGE. The message is conditional on separate passage, not an assertion that this rule vote itself passed H.R.2913. No deemed substantive amendment appears. This is noncounting procedural context under the established contract, not member direction on Ukraine support, a parent bill immigration component, visa/admission/removal policy or any realized effect. Foushee Yea and Massie Nay remain exact procedural observations.

claims.passage: [Congressional Bills 119th Congress] [From the U.S. Government Publishing Office] [H. Res. 518 Engrossed in House (EH)] <DOC> H. Res. 518 In the House of Representatives, U. S., June 4, 2026. Resolved, That immediately upon adoption of this resolution, the House shall proceed to the consideration in the House of the bill (H.R. 2913) to authorize support for Ukraine, and for other purposes. All points of order against consideration of the bill are waived. The bill shall be considered as read. All points of order against provisions in the bill are waived. The previous question shall be considered as ordered on the bill and on any amendment thereto to final passage without intervening motion except: (1) one hour of debate equally divided and controlled by the chair and ranking minority member of the Committee on Foreign Affairs or their respective designees; and (2) one motion to recommit. Sec. 2. Clause 1(c) of rule XIX and clause 8 of rule XX shall not apply to the consideration of H.R. 2913. Sec. 3. The Clerk shall transmit to the Senate a message that the House has passed H.R. 2913 no later than one week after passage. Attest: Clerk.
